description: This file is a shell script that contains test cases for visualizing git log graphs, including complex merge scenarios like skewed merges, nested merges, octopus merges, and multiple tips. It sets up git repository states, performs various merges, and verifies the resulting graph representations, often with color and date options.

methods.name: check_graph
methods.description: A function to compare the current git log graph output against an expected graph input, with a specified format.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: A function to define a test case that expects a certain git log graph output after setup.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: A function to set test configuration, such as graph colors.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: A function to create a new commit with a given label or message.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: A function to mark the completion of all tests.
